annotation.title_clean: Elements of an instrument and other possible measures to address emerging technologies in the area of LAWS (CCW/GGE.1/2024/WP.3)
annotation.title_en: Elements of an instrument and other possible measures to address emerging technologies in the area of LAWS (CCW/GGE.1/2024/WP.3)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bulgaria; Denmark; France; Germany; Italy et al. (submitting States, CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS)
annotation.venue: UN Office at Geneva, CCW GGE on LAWS
annotation.summary_en: Working paper from several European States to the CCW GGE on LAWS, dated March 2024. It proposes elements of a future two-tier instrument. The instrument would ban LAWS that cannot comply with IHL or that operate entirely outside human control. All other LAWS with autonomy in critical functions would face requirements for human control, testing, risk mitigation and accountability.
key_provisions_or_claims: Two-tier approach: ban some LAWS and regulate all others
Ban LAWS that are indiscriminate, uncontrollable, operate outside human control or cause superfluous injury
Retain human control across the whole life cycle, with testing, certification and operator training
Put risk-mitigation safeguards in place against bias, unintended engagements, loss of control and diversion
Individual responsibility can never be transferred to machines; States must create national accountability mechanisms
